settings.title: Settings
settings.shortcutIntro: An iOS Shortcut sends every Apple Pay purchase to your Kassa server. KassaLite then shows it here.
settings.installShortcutFooter: Copies the endpoint and your token, then opens the Shortcut. iCloud Shortcuts cannot take parameters: paste them where the Shortcut asks.
settings.copyFooter: Copies the address and your token. Paste them into the Shortcut as the setup steps describe.
settings.noShortcutToken: No Shortcut token stored. Pair this iPhone again.
settings.stepsTitle: How to set up the Shortcut

steps.1: Tap Install Shortcut. The endpoint URL (first line) and the Authorization value (second line, “Bearer …”) are copied to the clipboard.
steps.2: Open Shortcuts → Automation → + → Transaction. Pick your Wallet cards, choose Run Immediately, then Next → New Blank Automation.
steps.3: Add “Get Contents of URL”. URL: the first copied line (ends in /api/capture/shortcut). Method: POST. Headers: Authorization = the second copied line.
steps.4: Request Body: JSON with merchant = Shortcut Input › Merchant, amount = Shortcut Input › Amount, card = Shortcut Input › Card or Pass. Optional: add “Get Current Location” first and send street, city and country from it, so the notification says where you paid.
steps.5: Add “Get Dictionary Value” (key nudge) and “Show Notification” with that value.
steps.6: Pay with Apple Pay. The purchase shows up in Activity within seconds.

settings.serverFooter: Must be a stable https address, for example your named tunnel. Changing it does not re-pair: sign out and pair again if the server is different.
settings.signOutBody: The tokens on this iPhone are deleted. The Shortcut keeps working until you revoke it in the full app.
settings.updatesOff: Over-the-air updates are off in this build. Rebuild it from Xcode after setting the EAS project id (docs/OTA_UPDATES.md).
settings.updatesDebug: Debug build: the app loads from Metro and ignores updates. Run the Release configuration.
settings.updatesInfo: Channel {{channel}}, app version {{runtime}}. Updates only reach builds with the same channel and version.
settings.updatesEmbeddedHint: No over-the-air update applied yet. A new one downloads when the app opens and applies when it restarts.
